status: Evaluation only. Standard value 0 is proposed for the proportional rule; no production settings or splitter are changed.

definitions.scope: Local chunk ID generation, encryption, decryption, and leaf JSON serialisation using the installed window-fixed Commonlib candidate and the experimental proportional boundaries. No remote requests or production-policy changes.
definitions.leafBytes: Sum of one JSON object per new leaf, including synthetic one-generation revision history. Excludes Metadata, control documents, RPC/bulk wrappers, responses, and retries. Not a whole-sync traffic measurement.
definitions.ids: Actual 67-character independent keyed identifiers with the same public fixture key used by the previous local benchmark.
definitions.initialRtt: Reuse prior transport source models: Couch all-missing push 4K RTT, known-ID push audit 3K RTT, P2P one-way all-missing (2K+1) RTT at internal batch 33, Fast Fetch page 10000. Metadata/control count 16 retained only as a modelling assumption.
definitions.binaryModel: Independent uniform hashes with expected mean 0.48755M; ceil(fileBytes/mean) is a planning approximation, not an observed count. Adds one Metadata document and omits fixed controls.
definitions.breakEven: Illustrative mixed-corpus workload: one initial upload, then a 50/50 mix of the saved overwrite and insertion stages. Small edit batches assumed to remain in one Couch batch for all sizes. RTT and bandwidth are hypothetical; times omit CPU and Metadata/control byte differences. Not an observed workload or a universal optimum. Every hypothetical edit introduces novel content with the byte profile of a saved stage; it is not a literal replay or toggle of the same bytes, which could deduplicate completely.
definitions.cloudant: Compare serialised bytes conservatively against 1000000 per document and 64000000 per request. Internal Cloudant document accounting and service acceptance were not tested. Metadata, conflict histories, larger batches, and existing stored chunks remain separate constraints.

proposal.priority: Ongoing reuse, a common storage policy, and payload headroom; not universal minimum latency.

localProductionPipelineTiming.scope: Warm single-process initial leaf-production pipeline: split, text/base64 encoding, real keyed identifiers, E2EE V2, JSON serialisation. Excludes input I/O, Metadata, local DB, networking, decryption, and file reflection. Fresh HashManager and empty chunk cache per trial; one warm-up and three measured repetitions. Not a mobile or complete synchronisation benchmark.
